newsitem.title: USA: IMC-Agrico gets DAP deal in China.
newsitem.headline: IMC-Agrico gets DAP deal in China.

text.p: IMC-Agrico Co, a joint venture between IMC Global Inc and Freeport-McMoRan Resource Partners, said Wednesday they reached an agreement to sell diammonium phosphate (DAP) to China's Sinochem.
Under the agreement, which spans 1997 and 1998, China will receive monthly shipments of the fertilizer at market-related prices at the time of the shipments.
Total shipments will near 1996 levels in each of the two years. IMC-Agrico declined to disclose 1996 shipments.
The agreement was reached through the Phosphate Chemical Export Association, IMC-Agrico said.
IMC Global produces and markets agricultural products.
Freeport-McMoRan Resource Partners, which is 51-percent owned by Freeport-McMoRan Inc, mines and transports sulphur and develops oil reserves, in addition to its IMC-Agrico activities.
